neighbours.label: the token pieces 'abble' (Scr|abble), 'al' in Be|al and 'agle' in Be|agle
fire: On rainy evenings my grandparents still play Scrabble at the kitchen table.
She won the club's Scrabble tournament with a seven-letter word.
Washington guard Bradley Beal missed the game with a sore knee.
Fans cheered when Beal hit the winning shot at the buzzer.
Their Beagle barks every time the postman walks past.
My cousin bought a new Scrabble board for the holidays.
The coach said Beal would return to practice next week.
A friendly Beagle followed us all the way along the beach.

notes: Probe: Beal 0.89 ('al'), Scrabble 0.81 ('abble'), Beagle 0.45 ('agle'), Mistral 0.19 ('ral'). corral, babble and coral all scored 0.00, so this is a list of specific pieces, not a general -al or -le spelling unit. The tokenizer splits are checked (Scr|abble, Be|al, Be|agle).
